statement: Attributing imported evidence to its tool is not provenance: also record what the evidence is about and check it against the subject. Cejel's ingest funnel (src/witan/ingest.ts:82-132 and src/witan/public-scan.ts:100-145 at 1e17e8ce3) never read the subject or time a document declares. A Scorecard JSON for another repository, for another commit, or dated before the scanned commit existed scored exactly like a matching one, labelled operator_supplied. The same bytes at two paths scored twice (constructed repo: A4 3.1 to 2.8, B3 warning to critical). A missing check read as a match. Rule: per input, record its digest and declared subject, compare that with the scanned revision, and refuse on request. Never infer the subject from clone state.
